parcel_id.label: parcel_id
parcel_id.desc: City of Toronto parcel identifier. Unique per parcel; the key to join back to source data.

address.label: address
address.desc: Municipal address. Toronto's parcel layer carries no address, so this is matched spatially: an address point inside the parcel, else the nearest within 20 m. Blank on 0.2%.

zone.label: zone
zone.desc: Zone symbol: RD detached, RS semi-detached, RT townhouse, RM multiple, R residential, plus commercial and other zones where the shape filter caught them. Blank on 7%.

frontage_m.label: frontage_m
frontage_m.desc: Lot width at the street: the side of the parcel's minimum rotated rectangle facing the centreline segment the address sits on. Measuring against the nearest centreline of any kind instead put lots with a rear or side laneway the wrong way round, and took the flanking street on corner lots.

depth_m.label: depth_m
depth_m.desc: The other side of that rectangle.

area_m2.label: area_m2
area_m2.desc: True polygon area, not frontage x depth.

front_setback_m.label: front_setback_m
front_setback_m.desc: Required front yard under the averaging rule 10.5.40.70(1): match or average the abutting buildings within 15 m fronting the same street, with 6.0 m as fallback. Populated on all rows. Median 6.4 m.

side_setback_m.label: side_setback_m
side_setback_m.desc: Required side yard, houseplex rates. R and RT 0.9 m; RD banded on req_frontage_m from 0.6 to 3.0 m; RS banded 0.6 to 1.5 m; RM 1.2 m. Blank in non-residential zones.

rear_setback_m.label: rear_setback_m
rear_setback_m.desc: Required rear yard. R and RT a flat 7.5 m; RD, RS and RM the greater of 7.5 m or 25% of lot depth.

buildable_width_m.label: buildable_width_m
buildable_width_m.desc: frontage_m minus the side yards: two where the building is detached, one where it has a party wall, and on a qualifying RD corner lot the 3.0 m flankage yard in place of one of them.

depth_available_m.label: depth_available_m
depth_available_m.desc: depth_m minus the front and rear yards: the depth available to the MAIN building. The rear yard has already been taken out, and that is where a garden suite goes -- the two do not compete for this space. What a garden suite actually gets is rear_remaining_m.

max_coverage_pct.label: max_coverage_pct
max_coverage_pct.desc: Maximum share of the lot any building may cover. AN OVERLAY: only 46% of residential lots have one. Where blank the limit comes from the by-law chapter default, which is not published as GIS and is still outstanding.

coverage_cap_m2.label: coverage_cap_m2
coverage_cap_m2.desc: area_m2 x max_coverage_pct. Blank wherever coverage is.

corner_lot.label: corner_lot
corner_lot.desc: Abuts two or more streets, excluding laneways. Corner lots take a wider flankage setback. 4% of residential lots.

lane_access.label: lane_access
lane_access.desc: A laneway centreline runs within 6 m of the lot boundary, which for a 4.5 to 6 m lane means it abuts. Separate from corner_lot: a lane at the rear is access, not a corner. Tested at 20 m before, which caught lanes serving the opposite side of the street.

on_major_street.label: on_major_street
on_major_street.desc: Within 30 m of a Major Street. Major Streets switch townhouses and apartments to a different setback regime (window-dependent side yards), not yet modelled. 5% of lots.

attached.label: attached
attached.desc: The building on the lot shares a party wall with its neighbour, or the zone is RS. Detected where one 3D Massing footprint spans two or more parcels. An attached building has one side yard, not two.

building_depth_m.label: building_depth_m
building_depth_m.desc: Depth of the building this parcel ends up with. On a new build, the depth that reaches a 975 sq ft footprint, held under the by-law ceiling of 17 m -- 19 m only for a houseplex on a deep lot, meaning depth 36 m or more with frontage under 10 m, or depth 40 m or more with frontage 10 m or over (D1 T04/T05), held between 10 and 19 m and never past the rear yard, then shortened where the 1,400 sq ft cap or a lot coverage cap binds. On a conversion, the existing building's depth. The 900 sq ft target and the 10 m floor are assumptions, not by-law.

rear_remaining_m.label: rear_remaining_m
rear_remaining_m.desc: Distance from the back of the main building to the REAR LOT LINE: lot depth less the front yard and the building. The rear yard is NOT subtracted, because that is exactly where a garden suite sits -- D1 T17/T18 measure the triggers to the lot line. Taking it off the rear setback line instead suppressed 216,000 suites.

ground_floor_sqft.label: ground_floor_sqft
ground_floor_sqft.desc: Footprint of every floor. On a conversion this is the existing building; on a new build it is the setback envelope. The step-back on wide conversions -- upper floors pulling in to the as-of-right envelope -- is switched off pending Noam, so all four levels are taken at this area.

garden_suite_sqft.label: garden_suite_sqft
garden_suite_sqft.desc: GROSS FLOOR AREA of the garden suite, across both storeys where it has two. The envelope is the depth left to the rear lot line once the separation (4.0 m at one storey, 7.5 m at two) and the suite's own rear yard are taken, by the width between its side yards (the greater of 1.5 m or 10% of frontage, capped at 3.0 m). Capped at 60 m2 for one storey and 120 m2 for two, and never larger than the main building.

garden_suite_storeys.label: garden_suite_storeys
garden_suite_storeys.desc: 0, 1 or 2, from rear_remaining_m: 9.0 m for one storey, 12.5 m for two, or 14.15 m for two on a lot deeper than 45 m. Each is built from by-law parts -- separation from the main building, 3.5 m of suite, and the suite's own rear yard. Set to 0 where the suite would be under 3.5 m deep, and where a sixplex has already filled the lot's 6-unit cap (T20). One unit whatever its height.

sixplex_eligible.label: sixplex_eligible
sixplex_eligible.desc: Five or six units are permitted: the lot is in one of the nine wards of OPA 818 / By-law 654-2025 (the Toronto and East York District plus Ward 23) AND the building is detached, which the by-law requires. 10.7% of parcels.

unit_type.label: unit_type
unit_type.desc: Bachelor through 4 bed, from the architect's size bands. The bands overlap, so a floor is typed as the largest band its area reaches.

n_units.label: n_units
n_units.desc: n_units_main plus one where a garden suite fits.

total_gfa_sqft.label: total_gfa_sqft
total_gfa_sqft.desc: Floor area of the main building across the levels that hold a unit, each at ground_floor_sqft.
